summary:
Verified fix for POST /api/li-search/message/script (f-string crash on special chars). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed including new special-chars test (newlines, $, *, &, %). Frontend e2e: selected 2 connections at /linkedin-search, filled textarea with 'Hello Dr..

I am the founder of HearClear.
* AI-based screening
* $100 & 50%', clicked 'Send to 2 Connections via LinkedIn' — script (2584 chars) returned 200, clipboard contains json.dumps-escaped message, success toast 'Auto-send script copied to clipboard' shown. Regressions: /api/health healthy; /api/li-search/posts returned 20 posts. Login used Agent@2024! via /api/auth/agent-login.

minor.issue: MongoDB '_id' (ObjectId) leaks into response payload. Per code-review rules, _id should be excluded.

action_items: Optional: strip MongoDB '_id' from /api/li-search/connections responses (and similar endpoints) to comply with API hygiene.
critical_code_review_comments: generate_message_script now correctly uses json.dumps + string concatenation — safe for arbitrary Unicode/special chars.
Consider adding server-side length limit for message and recipients to prevent oversized script generation.
MongoDB ObjectId '_id' is being serialized to clients in connections listing endpoint — should be excluded.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_message_script.py (updated test_script_escapes_backticks for new json.dumps output; added test_script_special_chars_newlines_dollar_asterisk)
test_credentials: Agent password: Agent@2024! (via /api/auth/agent-login and /linkedin-search password prompt).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix is verified. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_message_script.py covers valid, empty-recipients, empty-message, missing-both, backticks/${} and the newlines+$+*+& special-chars regression. Frontend flow at /linkedin-search → Messaging tab; connections are selected by clicking cards (no checkboxes). Password 'Agent@2024!' via 'Access' button on /linkedin-search page.
rca of the issue: Previous impl used Python f-strings whose body embedded a JS backtick template literal containing the raw message. Any '{' or '}' in the message (or accidentally interpreted format specs) or f-string edge cases could crash server rendering; additionally raw newlines and $ in a JS template literal produced malformed JS. Fix: message and recipients are serialized via json.dumps() (proper JS string literal escaping) and the surrounding script is built by string concatenation instead of f-strings. Verified with special-char payload — no 500/502, script returned successfully.
